```lean
CategoryTheory.braidedCategoryOfFaithful.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {C : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [Category.{u_3, u_1} C]
  [Category.{u_4, u_2} D] [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalCategory D] (F : MonoidalFunctor C D) [F.Faithful]
  [BraidedCategory D] (β : (X Y : C) → MonoidalCategory.tensorObj X Y ≅ MonoidalCategory.tensorObj Y X)
  (w : ∀ (X Y : C), F.μ X Y ≫ F.map (β X Y).hom = (β_ (F.obj X) (F.obj Y)).hom ≫ F.μ Y X) : BraidedCategory C
```
***
Verifying the axioms for a braiding by checking that the candidate braiding is sent to a braiding
by a faithful monoidal functor.
